units.source_text: “很能吃，却不通大便，是肚子里的怪兽在吃食啊。

en.t: "He can eat a great deal, but he cannot pass stool; it is the monster in his belly that is eating the food.

units.source_text: 他虽没说以后还会比现在吃得更多，

en.t: Although he did not say that from now on he would eat even more than he does now,

units.source_text: 喉咙咽得更多，不过说那种怪兽好酒。

en.t: or swallow still more down his throat, he did say that such monsters like liquor.
I asked him what should be done about it.

units.source_text: 他说，去给病人向妙见菩萨求些卷寿司来，

en.t: He said to go and ask Myoken Bodhisattva for some rolled sushi for the sick man,

units.source_text: 用难得的线香熏熏房间……

en.t: and to smoke the room with precious incense sticks...

units.source_text: 听说这是怪兽缠身，让他弄错了时间，没什么大不了的变化。

en.t: I heard that this was a case of the monster possessing him and making him mistake the time; there was no great change to worry about.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，过去一片干松鱼都咽不下去，

en.t: Even so, in the past he could not swallow even a single shaving of dried bonito,

units.source_text: 近来却连寿司饭团什么的都能一口一个地咽下，

en.t: but lately he can swallow things like sushi rice balls one after another in a single gulp,

units.source_text: 每咽一口动一动喉核，看着很不顺眼。

en.t: and each time he swallows, his Adam's apple moves; it is very unpleasant to watch.

units.source_text: 狐仙降在巫女身上，也是那样咽东西的，

en.t: When a fox spirit descends into a shrine maiden, she swallows things in just that way too,

units.source_text: 而且前些日子他还狂饮呢。

en.t: and besides, the other day he was drinking wildly.
